title.zh: v2.16.0 手机随机播放真的会等一首放完；母带链不再吃掉侧链与渐强；GS-1 有了逐音音准与采样导入
title.en: v2.16.0 Phone Shuffle Waits for the Track; the Master Chain Stops Eating Ducks and Builds; GS-1 Gains Per-Note Tuning and Sample Import

highlights.zh: **手机播放器的播放顺序按钮修好了，两个原因都修了。** ① 换歌被误判成「一遍播完」：钩子把「步数往回跳」当作结束，而换 pattern 正好从 0 开始，于是每次切歌都触发下一次切歌——一步一首。现在真正的回绕需要**这个 pattern 自己的长度**，并在加载新 pattern 时清空观测值。② 「一首曲子」只有 4–16 秒（曲风自带 pattern 的长度），所以即使判定对了也还是连续切歌；手机端现在播**编排**（40 小节，八小节曲风约 80 秒），Electronic 走 club 结构、其余走 song 结构，浏览页的试听仍保留循环。
highlights.en: **The phone's play-order button works, and both causes are fixed.** (1) A track swap was read as a finished pass: the hook treated a backwards step as the end, and loading a pattern starts at step 0, so every swap triggered the next one — one genre per step. A real wrap now needs **the pattern's own length**, and the observation is cleared when a pattern loads. (2) A track was 4–16 seconds (the genre's own pattern), so even correct detection switched constantly; the phone no…

highlights.zh: **母带链不再把编排写进去的东西还回来。** 侧链下潜与渐强都被母带「恢复」掉了：总线压缩器与限幅天花板各加了释放保持（200 ms / 180 ms），实测 disco 文件里的下潜中位从 −0.3 dB 变成 **−3.82 dB**，`duckErasedInMaster` 从 1 收到 **0**；渐强改成在内容侧加深（club 编排的 intro→build 现在 10.5 dB），文件里的 build 从 +0.27 dB 变成 **+23%**，探针也改成断言这条下限而不是只报告。
highlights.en: **The master chain stops giving back what the arrangement wrote.** Both the sidechain dip and the build were being refilled: the bus compressor and the ceiling each gained a release **hold** (200 ms / 180 ms), which moved disco's file-level median dip from −0.3 dB to **−3.82 dB** and `duckErasedInMaster` from 1 to **0**; the build was deepened in the content instead (the club form's intro to build is 10.5 dB now), taking the file's build from +0.27 dB to **+23 %**, and the p…

highlights.zh: **立体声更宽了。** 解析后的声像缩放从 2.0 提到 3.0，门禁自己点名的两个 offender 越过 0.98（chicago-house 0.9865 → 0.9716，detroit-techno 0.9939 → 0.9736），单声道安全线（side 高于 −8 dB 才判不合格）仍在安全区。鼓、贝斯、军鼓仍留在混音表放的位置。
highlights.en: **Wider stereo.** The resolved-pan scale went from 2.0 to 3.0 and the gate's own two offenders crossed the 0.98 line (chicago-house 0.9865 to 0.9716, detroit-techno 0.9939 to 0.9736), with the mono-safe guard untouched (side above −8 dB is the failure). Kick, bass and snare stay where the mix table put them.
